skill.summary: Search for flights accommodating oversize baggage and sports equipment. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Enforced strict CLI-only responses: all results must originate from flyai CLI output, not training data.
- Added multi-language support: output language matches user input (English/Chinese).
- Specified detailed CLI parameter mapping and validation rules, including comprehensive environment and output checks.
- Expanded description to clarify supported booking services (flights, hotels, trains, etc.) powered by Fliggy.
- Updated output formatting rules: conclusions first, booking links required, minimum 3 results in comparison table when possible.
